-- ===================================================================================== -- [4-C] 폴더 레벨 색인 — "통합검색 > 프로젝트 > 폴더" 선택 시 사용 -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- V_ECM_FOLDERS가 PROJECT_ID, FOLDER_PATH, CREATOR_NAME을 이미 해결해서 내려준다. -- ACL은 폴더 자체 ACL_ID로, 공유는 V_ECM_SHARES(TARGET_TYPE='FOLDER')를 -- FOLDER_ID로 직접 조인해서 판단한다. -- ===================================================================================== */ WITH ACL_OWNER_FLAG AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ACL_ID FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS WHERE PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'OWNER' AND CAN_READ = 1 ), ACL_OGROUP_FLAG AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ACL_ID FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS WHERE PRINCIPAL_TYPE = 'OGROUP' AND CAN_READ = 1 ) SELECT -- ── 폴더 식별 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── D.FOLDER_ID AS "folderId", D.FOLDER_ID AS "dockey", D.NAME AS "folderName", D.NAME_EN AS "folderNameEn", D.NAME_CN AS "folderNameCn", D.PARENT_ID AS "parentFolderId", D."TYPE" AS "folderType", D.STATUS AS "folderStatus", D.DESCRIPTION AS "folderDescription", D.FOLDER_PATH AS "folderPath", D.MAP_NAME AS "gnbTabName", -- 전사문서/부서문서/프로젝트 D.CREATOR_ID AS "creatorId", D.CREATOR_NAME AS "creatorName", TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdDate", TO_CHAR(D.UPDATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedDate", '51000' AS "collapseCd",
-- ── 소속 프로젝트 ID + 프로젝트 필터용 속성(비정규화) ────────────── D.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", P.PROJECTNO AS "projectNo", -- 프로젝트 번호 P.PJTNAME AS "pjtName", -- 등록명(국문) 구성요소1 P.MISNAME AS "completionNm", -- 준공명(등록명 구성요소2) P.CONTRACTNAME AS "contractName", -- 계약명 P.NAME AS "projectName", -- 프로젝트명 P.SUBPROJECTNO AS "subProjectNo", -- 종속 프로젝트 번호 P.SUBMISNAME AS "subMisName", -- 종속 프로젝트명 CASE WHEN P.SUBPROJECTNO IS NOT NULL OR P.SUBMISNAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "isSubProject", -- 종속 프로젝트 여부(파생) P.SECURITYLEVEL AS "projectSecurityLevel", -- 프로젝트 보안등급(코드) P.SECURITYLEVEL_NM AS "projectSecurityLevelNm", -- 프로젝트 보안등급(명) P.SITEGUBUN1 AS "stdFolder1Cd", -- 표준폴더1 P.PROJECTGUBUNTITLE AS "stdFolder1Title", -- 표준폴더1 구분타이틀 P.SITEGUBUN2 AS "siteGubunCd", -- 현장구분 P.PROJECTGUBUN2 AS "stdFolder2Cd", -- 표준폴더2 P.PROJECTGUBUN2TITLE AS "stdFolder2Title", -- 표준폴더2 구분타이틀 P.SITEOPENYN AS "siteOpenYn", -- 현장개설여부 P.WORKGUBUN AS "workGubun", -- 업무구분(코드) P.WORKGUBUN_NM AS "workGubunNm", -- 업무구분(명) P.PARTICIPATIONINFO1 AS "orderTypeCd", -- 수주형태 P.PARTICIPATIONINFO1_NM AS "orderTypeNm", -- 수주형태(명) P.SERVICEGUBUN AS "serviceGubun", -- 용역구분(코드) P.SERVICEGUBUN_NM AS "serviceGubunNm", -- 용역구분(명) P.PROGRESS AS "wjgProgressCd", -- 우장각 진행상태(코드) P.PROGRESS_NM AS "wjgProgressNm", -- 우장각 진행상태(명) P.REGIONLEVEL1_NM AS "locationNm", -- 위치 P.USEADD AS "facilityUseCd", -- 용도시설 구분(코드) P.USEADD_NM AS "facilityUseNm", -- 용도시설 구분(명) P.MATERIALTYPEA AS "keyMaterialCd", -- 주요자료(코드) P.MATERIALTYPEA_NM AS "keyMaterialNm", -- 주요자료(명) P.DEPARTMENTPMNM AS "participantInPm", -- 대표PM P.GENERALMANAGERNM AS "participantInLeader", -- 단장 P.CONSUMER AS "participantExConsumer", -- 수요자 P.CONTRACTORDERER AS "participantExOrderer", -- 계약발주자 P.ORIGINALORDERER AS "participantExOrgOrderer", -- 원발주자 P.ADMITTER AS "participantExAdmitter", -- 허가권자 P.INSPECTOR AS "participantExInspector", -- 감독자 P.CONSTRUCTIONPM AS "participantExCm", -- 건설사업관리자 P.PROJECTOPERATOR AS "participantExOperator", -- 시행자 P.DESIGNER AS "participantExDesigner", -- 설계자 P.BUILDER AS "participantExBuilder", -- 시공자 P.CONSULTING AS "participantExConsulting", -- 컨설팅 P.JOINTCONTRACTOR AS "participantExJoint", -- 공동수행사 P.EXTERNALETC AS "participantExEtc", -- 기타 TO_CHAR(P.CONTRACT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "contractDate", -- 계약일자(원본) CASE WHEN P.CONTRACT_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "contractYn", -- 계약여부(파생) P.PARTICIPATIONINFO5_CO AS "jointPerformCd", -- 공동이행방식(코드) P.PARTICIPATIONINFO5_CO_NM AS "jointPerformNm", -- 공동이행방식(명) P.ENTERPRISETYPE AS "businessFieldCand", -- 사업분야 유력후보 P.DIVISIONBUSINESS2 AS "bizMethodCd", -- 시행방식(코드) P.DIVISIONBUSINESS2_NM AS "bizMethodNm", -- 시행방식(명) P.PARTICIPATIONSTEP AS "participationStep", -- 참여단계(코드) P.PARTICIPATIONSTEP_NM AS "participationStepNm", -- 참여단계(명) P.DIVISIONBUSINESS3 AS "buildActCd", -- 건축행위(코드) P.DIVISIONBUSINESS3_NM AS "buildActNm", -- 건축행위(명) P.TOTALEXPENSES AS "businessCost", -- 사업비(원) P.TOTALEXPENSESP AS "businessCostP", -- 사업비(평당) P.DESIGNEXPENSES AS "designPrice", -- 설계가격(원) P.DESIGNEXPENSESP AS "designPriceP", -- 설계가격(평당) P.INITIALCONSTRUCTIONEXPENSES AS "initConstructCost", -- 최초공사비(원) P.FINALCONSTRUCTIONEXPENSES AS "finalConstructCost", -- 최종공사비(원) TO_CHAR(P.DESIGNSTART_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "designStartDate", TO_CHAR(P.DESIGNEND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "designEndDate", TO_CHAR(P.BASICDESIGNSTART_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "basicDesignStartDate", TO_CHAR(P.BASICDESIGNEND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "basicDesignEndDate", TO_CHAR(P.WORKINGDESIGNSTART_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "workingDesignStartDate", TO_CHAR(P.WORKINGDESIGNEND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "workingDesignEndDate", TO_CHAR(P.PURCHASESTART_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "purchaseStartDate", TO_CHAR(P.PURCHASEEND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "purchaseEndDate", TO_CHAR(P.CONSTRUCTSTART_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "constructStartDate", TO_CHAR(P.CONSTRUCTEND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "constructEndDate", TO_CHAR(P.AFTERCONSTRUCTSTART_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "afterConstructStartDate", TO_CHAR(P.AFTERCONSTRUCTEND_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS "afterConstructEndDate", P.USELEVEL1 AS "buildingUseCd", -- 건축물의 용도(코드) P.USELEVEL1_NM AS "buildingUseNm", -- 건축물의 용도(명) P.AREA AS "totalArea", -- 면적(필터용 분류코드) P.TOTALFLOORAREA AS "totalFloorAreaM2", -- 연면적(㎡) P.SITEAREA AS "siteAreaM2", -- 대지면적(㎡) P.BUILDINGAREA AS "buildingAreaM2", -- 건축면적(㎡) P.SCALE AS "buildingScale", -- 규모(필터용 분류코드) P.GROUNDFLOORS AS "groundFloors", -- 지상 층수 P.UNDERGROUNDFLOORS AS "undergroundFloors", -- 지하 층수 P.CONFIRM AS "certGrade", -- 등급/인증(대표코드) P.GREENPC AS "greenPc", -- 녹색건축인증 예비인증 P.GREENMC AS "greenMc", -- 녹색건축인증 본인증 P.BUILDINGENERGYPC AS "buildingEnergyPc", -- 건축물에너지효율등급 예비인증 P.BUILDINGENERGYMC AS "buildingEnergyMc", -- 건축물에너지효율등급 본인증 P.ZEROENERGYPC AS "zeroEnergyPc", -- 제로에너지 예비인증 P.ZEROENERGYMC AS "zeroEnergyMc", -- 제로에너지 본인증 P.DESIGNCONDITION AS "designConditionCd", -- 설계조건(코드) P.DESIGNCONDITION_NM AS "designConditionNm", -- 설계조건(명) NULL AS "structureType", -- 구조(TODO) NULL AS "materialTech", -- 재료기술(TODO) P.BUILDINGMETHOD AS "buildMethodCd", -- 건축(코드) P.BUILDINGMETHOD_NM AS "buildMethodNm", -- 건축(명) P.MATERIALTECHCIVIL AS "civilTechCd", -- 토목(코드) P.MATERIALTECHCIVIL_NM AS "civilTechNm", -- 토목(명) P.MATERIALTECHMACHINE AS "machineTechCd", -- 기계설비(코드) P.MATERIALTECHMACHINE_NM AS "machineTechNm", -- 기계설비(명) P.MATERIALTECHELECTRIC AS "electricTechCd", -- 전기통신(코드) P.MATERIALTECHELECTRIC_NM AS "electricTechNm", -- 전기통신(명) P.MATERIALTECHFIRE AS "fireTechCd", -- 소방설비(코드) P.MATERIALTECHFIRE_NM AS "fireTechNm", -- 소방설비(명) P.PROFESSIONALMETHOD AS "specialtyCd", -- 전문분야(코드) P.PROFESSIONALMETHOD_NM AS "specialtyNm", -- 전문분야(명) CASE WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN P.DESIGNSTART_DATE AND P.DESIGNEND_DATE THEN '설계전단계' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN P.BASICDESIGNSTART_DATE AND P.BASICDESIGNEND_DATE THEN '기본설계단계' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN P.WORKINGDESIGNSTART_DATE AND P.WORKINGDESIGNEND_DATE THEN '실시설계단계' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN P.PURCHASESTART_DATE AND P.PURCHASEEND_DATE THEN '구매조달단계' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN P.CONSTRUCTSTART_DATE AND P.CONSTRUCTEND_DATE THEN '시공단계' WHEN SYSDATE BETWEEN P.AFTERCONSTRUCTSTART_DATE AND P.AFTERCONSTRUCTEND_DATE THEN '시공후단계' ELSE NULL END AS "currentProcessStage",
-- ── ACL: 폴더 자체 ACL_ID 기준 권한 태그 ───────────────────────── D.ACL_ID AS "folderAclId", ( (SELECT LISTAGG(R.PRINCIPAL_TYPE || ':' || R.PRINCIPAL_ID, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY R.PRINCIPAL_TYPE, R.PRINCIPAL_ID) FROM METAECM.V_ECM_ACL_READERS R WHERE R.ACL_ID = D.ACL_ID AND R.CAN_READ = 1 AND R.PRINCIPAL_TYPE NOT IN ('OWNER', 'OGROUP')) || (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACL_OWNER_FLAG O WHERE O.ACL_ID = D.ACL_ID) THEN '|USER:' || TO_CHAR(D.CREATOR_ID) END) || (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACL_OGROUP_FLAG G WHERE G.ACL_ID = D.ACL_ID) THEN '|' || (SELECT LISTAGG('DEPT:' || UG.GROUP_ID, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY UG.GROUP_ID) FROM METAECM.V_ECM_USER_GROUPS UG WHERE UG.USER_ID = D.CREATOR_ID) END) ) AS "aclPrincipalTags",
-- ── 공유(SHARE): 폴더 공유 대상 태그(FOLDER_ID 기준) ─────────────── (SELECT LISTAGG( CASE WHEN S.SHARED_IS_ALIAS = 1 THEN 'ALIAS:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID WHEN S.SHARE_TYPE = 1 THEN 'USER:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID ELSE 'DEPT:' || S.SHARED_USER_ID END, '|') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY S.SHARED_USER_ID) FROM METAECM.V_ECM_SHARES S WHERE S.TARGET_TYPE = 'FOLDER' AND S.TARGET_ID = D.FOLDER_ID AND BITAND(NVL(S.AUTHORITY, 0), 2) = 2) AS "sharePrincipalTags" -- 공유 권한 태그('|' 구분, 읽기(bit2) 권한만)
FROM METAECM.V_ECM_FOLDERS D JOIN METAECM.V_ECM_PROJECTS P ON P.PROJECT_ID = D.PROJECT_ID AND P.SAVE_STATUS = 'C' WHERE D.FOLDER_ID = :folderId
